name: 小猪和小猫（毛绒）
summary: 一对毛绒搭档：粉色羊毛毡小猪 + 橘色虎斑小猫（左耳别一个西瓜发夹）。针毡羊毛质感、豆豆眼、粉腮红、暖色木质房间、柔光浅景深，不加白描边。
look: Needle-felted wool plush toy characters, very soft fuzzy fibers, round chubby bodies, small black bead eyes, rosy pink cheeks, kawaii and gentle. The kitten: fluffy light-orange tabby with soft darker orange stripes, cream belly and paws, round cheeks, a small red-and-green watermelon-slice hair clip on its left ear, fluffy tail. The piglet: pink felted piglet with floppy ears, round snout, curly tail. Warm cozy wooden room background, soft warm light, shallow depth of field, square 1:1. No text.
notes: 小猫必须每张都戴左耳西瓜发夹（sheet-faces 里后三格漏了，以 cat-2 / sheet-cat 为准）。
